Trump defeats Harris to win the 2024 presidential election. Democrats are scrambling for answers: voters, lawmakers, strategists and experts are weighing in on what went wrong and why.

Vice President Kamala Harris delivered a concession speech at Howard University Wednesday after losing the presidential election to Donald Trump. She thanked her family, Tim Walz, President Biden, volunteers and election workers, and urged supporters to keep organizing.

Biden holds solo news conference at end of NATO summit, his first since the debate and first in eight months. He fielded questions on his candidacy, his ability to serve another term, and the war in Gaza.

President-elect Donald Trump has announced Brendan Carr as his pick to lead the Federal Communications Commission. Carr, a current FCC commissioner, has been a vocal critic of major media companies. The announcement came Sunday evening.

Two weeks after the June 27 debate, calls grow for Biden to step aside as the Democratic nominee. A new poll finds two-thirds of Americans say he should, and more House Democrats have called on him to step down. Biden has not withdrawn from the race.

Trump taps Dr. Mehmet Oz, the former TV host and heart surgeon, to lead Medicare and Medicaid. The pick requires Senate confirmation.

The Trump campaign says its internal communications were hacked and blames the Iranian government. The FBI is investigating the alleged hack attempts, which also targeted the Biden campaign. No conclusions have been announced yet.

Registration has opened for the Biden administration's Keeping Families Together program, which offers a path to citizenship for spouses of U.S. citizens who entered the country illegally, without requiring them to leave first. Not everyone is eligible. Details on who qualifies are in our full report.

Biden and Harris plan their first joint trip since Biden ended his campaign and Harris became the Democratic nominee, with the visit set for next week. The trip marks a visible show of unity as the party heads into the general election.

Harris reached out to Sen. J.D. Vance to congratulate him on his selection as Donald Trump's running mate. Reports say she left a message, then spoke with him directly and voiced hope for a vice presidential debate.

The International Brotherhood of Teamsters will not endorse a candidate in the 2024 presidential election, so neither Kamala Harris nor Donald Trump has won the union's backing.

Vice President Kamala Harris took questions from a live studio audience alongside Oprah Winfrey at a livestreamed campaign event in suburban Michigan on Thursday, fielding queries on immigration and gun control.

Remembering Corey Comperatore, the former fire chief killed in the attempted assassination of Donald Trump at a Butler, Pennsylvania rally. A candlelight vigil was held in Sarver, and a funeral followed in Pennsylvania. At the rally, Trump called for a moment of silence as Comperatore's firefighting gear was displayed on stage.

Trump and Elon Musk held a live interview on X tonight, about two hours long, after technical problems delayed the start. The platform is owned by Musk, who questioned Trump on his campaign and policy positions.
Biden authorizes Ukraine to use U.S.-supplied long-range missiles, including ATACMS, to strike targets inside Russia, reversing a longstanding U.S. restriction, U.S. officials confirmed Sunday.
Trump names Susie Wiles, who ran his 2024 campaign, as White House chief of staff. She will be the first woman to hold the job. Trump takes office Jan. 20.

President Biden, in his final address as president to the UN General Assembly, urged an end to the wars in the Middle East and Ukraine and defended his foreign policy record, while reflecting on his decision to step aside from the 2024 presidential race.

The Teamsters union announced it will not endorse a candidate in the 2024 presidential race, leaving both Kamala Harris and Donald Trump without its backing. The union's decision comes as both campaigns vie for working-class voters.

President Biden addressed the nation from the Oval Office on Monday, a day after former President Trump was targeted in an assassination attempt at a Pennsylvania rally. Biden spoke out against political violence, calling for unity and urging Americans to lower the temperature in political discourse.

Donald Trump turned 78 on Friday, celebrating at an event in West Palm Beach, Florida, where he addressed supporters alongside fans and Republican members. The campaign-season gathering drew a lively crowd.
